other_deposits: PXD069170 (plasma proteomics), PR002719 (metabolomics); skeletal-muscle RNA-seq re-used from Botella et al. (not in GSE308252, S9.3.13.p1)
assay: bulk RNA-seq, Illumina stranded mRNA, NextSeq 2000; Salmon v1.8.0 -> tximport -> DESeq2 (S9.3.14.p1, S9.3.15.p1)
sample_inclusion: Cohort 1 untrained-state plasma, 6 SIE and 6 MIE participants (all male), pre and 0 h (S9.3.18.p1, S9.2.1.1.p1)
sample_exclusion: one MIE adipocyte sample with RIN < 5 not processed for the 3 h experiment -> 5 MIE donors (S9.3.18.p1)

factors.name: intensity
factors.type: between-donor (plasma donor randomised to SIE or MIE)

primary_estimand: Effect of post-exercise (0 h) versus resting (pre) plasma from the same participant on the primary human adipocyte transcriptome after 3 h incubation, separately for sprint-interval (SIE) and moderate-intensity (MIE) exercise plasma; intensity dependence of that response.

planned_contrasts.name: SIE_post_vs_pre
planned_contrasts.definition: adipocytes + SIE 0 h plasma vs + SIE pre plasma, paired by plasma donor

planned_contrasts.name: MIE_post_vs_pre
planned_contrasts.definition: adipocytes + MIE 0 h plasma vs + MIE pre plasma, paired by plasma donor

blocking_or_covariance.locator: S9.3.15.p1 ('controlling for each subject in the linear model')

matrix_scale: Salmon/tximport gene-level counts as stored in DESeq2 (GEO: 'raw counts from DESeq2')
paper_formula: ~ subject + time (per experiment / per intensity; exact formula not printed)

paper_threshold.adjustment: BH (DESeq2 default padj; method not named in paper)

enrichment: GSEA (clusterProfiler, GO BP via msigdbr) ranked by DESeq2 Wald statistic (S9.3.15.p1)
